## Uploading K-1s and Documents (Already Built)

The portal already has a full document upload system. Here's how it works:

**From the Investor Detail page:**
1. Navigate to any investor (via Properties → investor row, or Investors tab → investor name)
2. Scroll to the bottom — there is a **Documents** section
3. Click **Upload Document** — you can drag and drop or browse for a PDF
4. Set the **category** (K-1, LP Agreement, Tax Form, Correspondence, or Other) and optionally the **year** (e.g. 2023)
5. The file is stored securely in cloud storage and linked to that investor

**From the Documents page (sidebar):**
- The Documents page lets you upload files and link them to both a property and an investor at the same time — useful for bulk uploads where you want to tag the property context too

The portal does **not yet** have a way to send documents to investors. There are two main approaches we could build:

| Approach | How it works | Best for |
|---|---|---|
| **Secure download link** | Generate a time-limited link for a specific document; email it to the investor | One-off sends, no investor login required |
| **Investor self-service portal** | Investor logs in with their email, sees only their own documents | Ongoing access, multiple documents, professional feel |

**My recommendation:** Start with the **secure download link** approach — it's faster to build and requires no change to how investors interact with the portal. Auto investor identification is now live. Here's what was built:

**How it works**

When a document is dropped into any upload dialog, the system immediately runs a fuzzy name match against all investors in the database — before you click Upload. The match uses the same normalized Levenshtein similarity engine already used for duplicate detection, stripping extensions, document-type keywords (K-1, Schedule, 2023, etc.), and legal suffixes to isolate the name portion of the filename.

**What you'll see in the UI**

- A **blue badge** (high confidence) or **amber badge** (medium confidence) appears below the dropzone showing the auto-detected investor name.
- For a single file with a high/medium match, the Investor dropdown is **pre-filled automatically**.
- For multiple files, each file gets its own suggestion badge.
- You can click **"Use"** to accept a suggestion, **"✕"** to dismiss it, or simply change the dropdown yourself to override.
- After upload, the results panel shows "Linked to [Investor Name]" for each auto-matched file.

**ZIP archives**

Each file extracted from a ZIP is matched individually on the server. PDFs inside a ZIP also have their text extracted (first 3,000 characters) to look for "Partner's name:" lines, giving even better accuracy for K-1 packets.

**Scope**

| Surface | Behavior |
|---|---|
| Documents page (global upload) | Auto-match runs; investor dropdown pre-fills |
| Property detail page (Attach Document) | Auto-match runs per file; per-file suggestion badges |
| Investor detail page (Attach Document) | Investor already known — no match needed |
| ZIP upload (any surface) | Per-file server-side match with PDF text extraction |
